product.description: IEC 60320 C14 to IEC 60320 C15 power cords are commonly used between Cisco® or Juniper® Networks rack mounted equipment and the PDU in a data cabinet. Extend the reach of your AC powered device using this AC power extension cord to energize equipment from a distant power outlet. This cable features a standard, grounded IEC 60320 C14 plug on one end and an IEC 60320 C15 receptacle on the other.
